tagline: The world's leading testing, inspection and certification company
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu est le principal indicateur de performance pour SGS, acteur global de testing et certification.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue — total sales generated over the period.
kpis.description: Revenue reflects overall demand for compliance and quality services, driven by international regulations.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: The operating margin shows the company's ability to control its costs while growing.

kpis.name: R&D as % Revenue
kpis.description: Les activités de R&D sont limitées aux méthodes d'analyse et à la conformité réglementaire.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Capex supports analytical capacity and compliance with new standards.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: L'effectif reflète l'expansion géographique et la demande pour des inspections locales.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, sourced from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

ai_positioning.summary: SGS adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, progressively integrating it into analysis and reporting processes without making it a major strategic lever.
evidence: Use of AI for automation of certain analysis readings
Limited deployment to specific use cases such as anomaly detection
Absence of AI mentions in strategic priorities or financial results
